continuity_rules.architecture: same building style throughout scene unless location changes
continuity_rules.clothing: same clothing for same character unless time skip indicated
continuity_rules.weather: gradual transitions, no sudden weather changes within scene
continuity_rules.lighting: consistent light direction within time period, gradual shift for time passage
continuity_rules.season: same season throughout unless explicitly transitioning
continuity_rules.palette: maintain base palette, accent colors can shift with emotion

motion_rules.camera_in_scene: max 2 camera movements per shot, prefer static or single movement
motion_rules.character_motion: subtle gestures, avoid exaggerated movement unless action scene
motion_rules.environment_motion: wind in grass/trees, smoke rising, fire flickering — always present
motion_rules.light_motion: fire flicker, cloud shadows, dawn light progression
